votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to approve Ordinance No. 2023-002 annexing property into the City of St. George, and adjusting the corporate boundary lines, to include 163.1055 acres with the condition that a 90’ right of way that is included in the road master plan be granted within a year. [Recording 1]
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Hughes to approve the Cooperative Agreement with UDOT for the installation of a Traffic Signal at Sunset Boulevard and 1300 West.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Resolution No. 2023-006R providing for a special bond election to be held on November 21, 2023, for the purpose of submitting to the qualified electors of the City of St. George, Utah a proposition regarding the issuance of not to exceed $29,000,000 General Obligation Bonds and to change the date of the canvass to December 6, 2023.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve RAP Tax Grants distribution list.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Resolution No. 2023-007R entering into an Interlocal Agreement with the County for the 2023 Byrne Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) Program Award.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Resolution No. 2023-008R authorizing the Mayor to sign the Interlocal Cooperation Agreement for Facility Rentals between City of St. George and Washington County School District.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to approve Ordinance No. 2023-003 amending Title 10-8D-1 of the St. George City Code to add Food Truck Park as a permitted with standards use, to amend Title 10-17A to add Food Truck Park along with its specific standards, and to amend Title 10-19-5 to add off-street parking requirements for Food Truck Parks for a project to be called Food Truck Park with the following changes: 1) requirements to move the truck from 12:00 am – 6:00 am, shall not be required, instead they be required to be road ready and well maintained; 2) a condition that if there is a commissary kitchen, a grease interceptor will be required; and 3) parking lot must be paved per City standards. St. George City Council Regular Meeting Minutes Director Cameron Cutler, and Mayor Randall: 01:36:00 [Recording 1]
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2023-001 amending an approved PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) on approximately 0.27 acres, located at 184 North 200 West Street for the purpose of adding a 12-room boutique hotel for a project to be known as STG Inn, with conditions from the Planning Commission.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2023-004 amending the city zoning map by amending the zone from C-2 (Highway Commercial) and OS (Open Space) to PD-R (Planned Development Residential) and adopting a development agreement on approximately 19.72 acres, located west of the 900 South and 250 West intersection for the purpose of allowing a 224-unit multi-family development to be known as Soleil Ridge Apartments, with conditions from Planning Commission and that the fence match what is behind it. [Recording 2]
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the conditional use permit to build a new City Hall building and parking structure located on the northeast corner of Main Street and 100 South Street for a project to be called City Hall noting that the exteriors are not presented as they will be.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve the preliminary plat for Cove Valley, an 11-lo residential subdivision on 2.61 acres located at approximately 2500 East and 5550 South, on the extension of Malitsoh Way, north of White Dome Drive.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve the preliminary plat for Estates at Old Farm, a 21-lot residential subdivision on 14.50 acres located north of 2450 South Street and east of 2580 East Street.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to approve the preliminary plat for Sunshine Way Subdivision, a 3-lot residential subdivision on 0.61 acres located on the northwest corner of 200 South Street and 200 West Street.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to approve the preliminary plat for The Estates at Copper Ridge.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to appoint Terri Draper to the Planning Commission.
A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to adjourn.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
